height_mm.conditions: package outline DSQ0010A, WSON - 0.8 mm max height (toleranced 0.7-0.8)

v_in_min.conditions: recommended IN voltage range. The IN operating voltage range restricted by VDPM and VOVP is 4.45 V to 6.45 V; UVLO exit is 3.3 V typ.

v_in_max.conditions: recommended IN voltage range (30 V absolute maximum rating). Input overvoltage protection trips at 6.65 V typ on BQ24040/45, so useful operation is bounded well below this.

i_quiescent.conditions: ICC active supply current into IN terminal; TS = open, VIN = 6 V, TTDM, no load on OUT, VOUT > VOUT(REG), IC enabled; 1 mA max. Standby current into IN is 125 uA max (TS = LO, VIN <= 6 V); battery current into OUT with VIN = 0 V is 1 uA max.

i_max.conditions: recommended current at OUT terminal (and at IN terminal); absolute maximum continuous output current is 1.25 A. Programmed fast-charge current range is 10 mA to 1000 mA set by RISET.

theta_ja.conditions: DSQ (WSON) 10 pins, 2x2 mm, with exposed thermal pad; TI Thermal Information table, board condition not stated in the table

variables.v_in: Voltage at the IN terminal -- from the mission operating point (USB 5 V or an unregulated adapter). Worst case dissipation is at maximum VIN.
variables.v_out: Voltage at the OUT terminal, the shared battery/system node
variables.i_out: Total current leaving the OUT terminal (battery charge current plus any parallel system load)
variables.v_bat: Battery pack voltage. Section 11.3 instructs using 3.4 V as the minimum for maximum-dissipation calculations, because the pack reaches ~3.4 V within the first 2 minutes of fast charge and the thermal time constant of the assembly is longer than that.
variables.i_bat: Current actually flowing into the battery pack, set by the RISET fast-charge programming resistor (IOUT = KISET / RISET) -- a design choice, not a part property

t_junction_max.conditions: recommended operating junction temperature; absolute maximum TJ is 150 C. The internal thermal regulation loop begins reducing charge current at TJ(REG) = 125 C typ and thermal shutdown occurs at TJ(OFF) = 155 C typ (page 8).

design_notes.note: Maximum power dissipation occurs at the START of the charge cycle, when the battery voltage is lowest -- not at steady state. TI directs using 3.4 V as the battery voltage for worst-case dissipation, since the pack reaches roughly that within 2 minutes and the assembly's thermal time constant is longer.

The part self-limits: an internal control loop monitors junction temperature and reduces charge current once TJ(REG) = 125 C is exceeded, so the thermal emission saturates rather than running away, at the cost of a longer charge. TI recommends the design NOT run in thermal regulation under nominal input voltage and nominal ambient.

The thermal pad is BOTH the heat path and the main ground connection for the device. Use multiple 10 mil vias in the power pad conducting to a bottom ground plane, and do not let traces cut off that thermal path. A thinner PCB gives less temperature rise; the EVM uses 0.031 in board with 2 oz copper top and bottom as the optimal-performance reference.

Keep all low-current GND connections separate from the high-current charge/discharge paths from the battery, joining them with a single-point ground that ties small-signal ground and power ground together at one place. High charge-path traces into IN and out of OUT must be sized for the maximum charge current to avoid voltage drops.

provenance.notes: No emissions.conducted entry: the BQ2404x is a LINEAR charger with an internal PowerFET pass element, so it has no switch node and no switching fundamental. Its dominant emission is heat, and dissipation is captured as a formula (Equation 9) rather than a number because it depends on the input source, the shared OUT-node voltage, and the RISET-programmed charge current. susceptibility.thermal.t_op_min and t_op_max are ABSENT: this datasheet specifies no ambient temperature range at all -- Recommended Operating Conditions give only TJ (max 125 C), Absolute Maximum Ratings give TJ -40 C to 150 C, and Electrical Characteristics are specified over 0 C <= TJ <= 125 C. A full-text search for 'ambient temperature' returns only the theta_JA definition on page 31. Only one theta_JA entry exists: the part ships in a single DSQ/WSON-10 package and TI gives no second copper-area condition. Page numbers are PDF page numbers, which coincide with the printed page numbers in this document.
